findings.note: internal/mutationfresh/content_test.go:39-45 (TestWorktreeReadErrorsStopTheReview) chmod(0o000) on a file and a directory then expects Read to fail; as root (common in containerized CI images) permission checks are bypassed, so the read would succeed and the test's t.Error would fire, giving a false failure signal rather than verifying the intended error path. Companion of the same pattern in classify_test.go (shard-04). Test-hygiene gap only; the reviewed content.go read logic itself (Worktree/Head paths, symlink handling, gitlink exclusion) is otherwise sound.
